names.name: Nomi
names.said: Needles bound with silk to a wooden rod

instrument.points: a group of needles, bound in a flat or round cluster
instrument.held_by: the rod rests on one hand and is pushed with the other, at a shallow angle

text.what: A wooden rod with a group of needles bound to the end in silk, pushed at a shallow angle rather than straight down.
text.story:
*Tebori* means carving by hand. The angle is what separates it from every other poking tool on this site: the needles go in obliquely, which is how the method lays the graded blacks that Japanese work is built on.

A machine can outline faster. Practitioners who keep the rod usually keep it for the shading.
